# Didoo AI - Your AI Media Buyer, Built for SMBs

> Didoo AI is your dedicated AI Media Buyer—not a tool you log into, but an employee you message. It learns your voice, remembers what works, runs your Meta and Google campaigns 24/7, and optimizes autonomously as trust builds. Onboard in minutes, manage by Slack or WhatsApp, scale with confidence.

Key topics: AI Media Buyer, Meta ads, Facebook ads, Instagram ads, Google Ads, AI advertising, SMB marketing, autonomous ad optimization, AI-native agent. Visit didoo.ai for more information.


## Core Capabilities

- **Strategizes With You**: Analyzes your data, spots patterns, debates trade-offs before spending. Brings recommendations, not just reports.
- **Executes End-to-End**: Generates ad sets, writes copy, designs creatives, adjusts Meta/Google configs directly. No hand-offs. No waiting.
- **Always in Your Pocket**: Slack, WhatsApp, Teams—whatever you use. Ask at midnight, get an answer in seconds. It even pings you when opportunities show up.
- **Remembers Everything**: Your business stage, your wins, your quirks, your "never again" moments. Builds a living memory of what works for you, getting sharper every campaign.
- **Yours Alone**: Your AI instance and data belong to you—isolated cloud, dedicated infrastructure. Download everything anytime, or wipe it completely. We can't see it. No one can.


## How It Works

1. **Share Your Business** — Tell it what you sell, who you serve, what success looks like. It asks the right questions—no forms, no guesswork.
2. **Launch or Hand Over** — Start fresh with new campaigns, or point it to live Meta/Google ads. It audits what's running and takes the wheel.
3. **Manage by Message** — "Scale the winners." "Kill the losers." "Try a new angle." Just message it like your media buyer. It executes, reports back, waits for your next move.
4. **Watch It Adapt—Then Let It Run** — Every preference, every result—it remembers. Eventually it optimizes autonomously: bids, creative, budget. You stay in control, but you don't have to be in the room.


## Solution Guides

- [Smart Testing](https://didoo.ai/smart-testing): Stop guessing. Start remembering. Every A/B test teaches your AI what works—no insight wasted, no mistake repeated.
- [Auto-Execution](https://didoo.ai/auto-execution): From idea to live ad in minutes. Generate, build, deploy—all in one conversation. Zero hand-offs.
- [Always-On](https://didoo.ai/always-on): Your media buyer never sleeps. Message anytime, get answers in seconds, or let it alert you first.
- [Scale Confidently](https://didoo.ai/scale-confidently): Scale what works, kill what doesn't, know the difference. Data-driven strategy before you spend.
- [Faster Campaigns](https://didoo.ai/faster-campaigns): Launch speed that matches market speed. Brief to live before your competitor finishes their coffee.
- [AI-Native Platform](https://didoo.ai/ai-native-platform): Why agent architecture beats wrapped tools. Built different, for different results.

## Key Differentiators

| Factor | Didoo AI | Agency | In-House | Other AI Tools |
|--------|----------|--------|----------|----------|
| Relationship | Dedicated AI employee you message | Account manager, rotating team | Single hire, single point of failure | Dashboard you check |
| Memory | Learns your business permanently | Starts fresh with staff turnover | Depends on documentation | Resets every session |
| Availability | 24/7, instant response | Business hours, 24-48h lag | Sick days, vacations, quit | Self-serve only |
| Execution | End-to-end: strategy → live ads | Strategy only, execution outsourced | Limited by skillset | Creative or targeting, never both |
| Data ownership | Yours alone, isolated, exportable | Shared, often locked | Yours | Trained on by vendor |
| Optimization | Autonomous within your guardrails | Weekly manual reviews | When bandwidth allows | Rules-based, not learning |
| Cost | Flat SaaS, cancel anytime | $3K+/mo + % of spend | Salary + benefits + tools | Cheap but ineffective |
| Scale | Unlimited campaigns, unlimited learning | Headcount bound | Hire per channel | Linear effort required
